versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this release.

- Version bump only; no file or documentation changes detected.

- Initial release of postking-competitor-intel skill: enables discovery, registration, classification, and analysis of a brand's competitors on PostKing.
- Provides a structured procedure with dedicated tools for probing, classifying, registering, analyzing, and reviewing competitors.
- Adds optional features for deeper intelligence: head-to-head competitor comparisons and AI-synthesized landscape overviews.
- Outlines clear prerequisites, expected outcomes, common pitfalls, and ways to verify correct operation.
- Details both MCP tool invocation and available CLI equivalents for competitor management tasks.
